title: UTM and AAM KPI candidates in SysML v2: model, calculability analysis and synthetic data
description: SysML v2 library of 31 system-level KPI candidates for UTM and AAM anchored in the FAA UTM and UAM concepts of operations, the calculability analysis computed as a query over the model, synthetic data generators and experiments for four prioritized candidates, and a dashboard. Scenario values are illustrative; results are not empirical validation.
